name: goal-flow
description: Plan, execute, verify, and deliver long software tasks with evidence-backed gates.

interface.shortDescription: Adaptive task harnesses with recovery guidance
interface.longDescription: A lightweight Codex-native workflow that classifies task shape and risk, chooses a task-sized harness, tracks behavior changes, restores compact project context, and provides evidence-backed recovery guidance and approvals.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $goal-flow to classify this task, choose the smallest safe harness, plan, execute, verify, and deliver it reliably.
